system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Choose one willing negotiating partner who can understand you. Make a Guile roll toward the concession you seek. On a Standard result, add 3 progress. Learn a counteroffer the listener would accept.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
One minute per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One willing negotiating partner who can understand you.
Type
Skill

Make a Guile roll toward the concession you seek.

Weak
2 progress.
Standard
3 progress; learn a counteroffer the listener would accept.
Strong
4 progress; learn the least costly counteroffer the listener would accept in the present circumstances.
